text:
Situation: Cefotetan is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East has 9.5 days on hand of CEFOTETAN DISODIUM 1G0ML 10ML SDV at 4.1 vials per day. Corvale Lakeside has 26.9 days on hand of the same strength at 0.9 vials per day. Other sites hold additional stock ranging from 10.6 to 22 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows a shortage first posted on 2014-08-14, since resolved. FDA inspection 955350 at ACS Dobfar S.p.A. (FEI 3006028606) ended 2016-01-19 and was classified OAI with 14 observations on laboratory controls and written procedures. That OAI classification occurred 523 days after the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2017-01-13. Our Corvale Lakeside and Corvale East sites use NDC 63323038510 labeled by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and manufactured at ACS DOBFAR SPA (FEI 3006028606 and 3002807084).

Our position: Current inventory supports an internal transfer to balance supply. No active FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate NDCs from Fresenius Kabi and PAI Pharma are pre-approved for substitution.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 11 vials of 1 g/10 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — needs buyer approval.
3. Substitute CEFOTETAN DISODIUM 1 g/10mL from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC change) — needs pharmacist approval.
4. Substitute Cefotetan 1 g/10mL from PAI Holdings, LLC dba PAI Pharma (NDC change) — needs pharmacist approval.

Not recommended: No action; East would fall below two weeks supply.
